Name: The kitten's home
Author: RistaXcorpsekitty
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#ea9999]🐱 The Kitten's Farmhouse 🐱[/color][/b][/size][/center]

Tired of the old wooden farmhouse? Make your farm a hundred times cuter with this total exterior overhaul! This mod changes the default farmhouse into a cozy, adorable kitten-shaped cottage.

[size=4]✨ Features[/size]

Full Stage Support: Completely changes the exterior for all three upgrade levels of your farmhouse (Starter, Kitchen upgrade, and Nursery upgrade). Content Patcher Powered: Safe to install and uninstall at any time without damaging your original game files. Pixel Perfect: Clean aesthetic designed to fit the game's original charm.
__________________________________________________________________

[color=#cc0000][size=5]⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTES (Please read before playing!)[/size][/color]

To ensure the mod displays perfectly and you don't experience any visual glitches, please follow these two rules:

1. 🎨 Reset House Painting (For 1.6+ Users)
If you have previously painted your house at Robin's carpenter shop, the vanilla colors will bleed through the kitten texture.

Fix: Go to Robin, open the "Paint Buildings" menu, select your house, and click the "Reset" button to restore it to the default look.
2. 🔥 Keep the Fireplace Off!
The chimney smoke animations are currently not aligned with the new kitten roof structure. Lighting the fireplace inside will cause the smoke to drift from an incorrect spot in the air.

Recommendation: Please keep your fireplace turned off for now until the custom particle update is released.
__________________________________________________________________

[size=4]🛠️ Installation[/size]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Install the latest version of Content Patcher.
3. Download this mod and extract the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
4. Run the game using SMAPI!

[size=4]🐾 Credits & Feedback[/size]
Created with love! If you encounter any unexpected visual bugs or texture overlapping, please leave a comment in the "Posts" tab. Enjoy your new cat-tastic home!
